description: Gate 2 Step 5 batch 2 — repair 46 meta descriptions that end mid-sentence in an ellipsis or run past the 160-character limit. Most also carry a stuffed keyword prefix or the duplicated "تعلم المزيد مع أكاديمية كلوفرز" tail, both repaired in the same edit. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: batch 1 reported 62 defective descriptions; that was measured with a Latin-only regex and missed every Arabic row. Re-measured 2026-09-04 across the same 200 published articles: 44 stuffed prefix, 39 ellipsis, 14 boilerplate tail, 7 over 160 chars — 75 distinct articles. Replacements are hand-written, 100-160 characters, complete sentences. The Arabic ones are written as Arabic, not repaired as translations, and correct five machine-translation errors including a shamanic rite (굿) published as "the intestinal tract" — but brand and exam names (Duolingo, Rosetta Stone, Memrise, Babbel, Klovers, TOPIK, K-Drama, K-Pop) stay in Latin script, because those are the query. description column only; title, slug, keywords and content untouched. The ~29 prefix-only rows are batch 3.
